name: NDC Ground Truth LOD Generation via Least-Squares Plane Fitting
definition: A method to compute ground truth data for Neural Distance Fields (NDC) by fitting planes to intersection points within grid cells, storing results in multi-resolution LOD grids saved to HDF5.
summary: NDC Ground Truth LOD Generation via Least-Squares Plane Fitting creates multi-resolution training data for Neural Distance Fields by fitting planes to surface intersection points, differing from gradient-based methods by explicitly using computed intersections and normals.
